title: Dissolution of Mt. Angel Fire District
ballot_label: Dissolution of Mt. Angel Fire District. Question: Shall the Mt. Angel Fire District be dissolved, contingent on formation of new district and dissolution of Monitor District?
summary: Would dissolve the Mt. Angel Fire District and end its permanent tax rate, but only if voters also approve dissolving the Monitor Rural Fire Protection District (Clackamas Measure 3-640) and forming the Mt. Angel-Monitor Fire District (Measure 24-529). Employees, assets and liabilities would transfer to the new district, which would levy a permanent rate of $1.97 per $1,000 of assessed value. Dissolution effective December 31, 2026.
yes_means: A yes vote dissolves the Mt. Angel Fire District and ends its tax rate, effective only if the Monitor district dissolution and the new Mt. Angel-Monitor Fire District formation also pass.
no_means: A no vote keeps the Mt. Angel Fire District in place; without all three measures passing, the district continues to operate separately under its current tax rate.
fiscal_impact: The Mt. Angel Fire District's permanent tax rate would no longer be levied; property would instead be subject to the new district's permanent rate of $1.97 per $1,000 of assessed value. The district carries no bonded debt or long-term financial obligations.

arguments.author: Mt. Angel Fire District (official ballot title summary)
arguments.statement: The official ballot summary says the new district would provide services with career and volunteer members, add daytime staffing to address a daytime volunteer shortage, and replace apparatus reaching end-of-life around 2032.
arguments.excerpt: January 1, 2027, fire protection and emergency medical services provided by new district career and volunteer members, with increased daytime staffing to address a daytime volunteer shortage and replacement of apparatus reaching end-of-life around 2032.

collection_notes: yes_means/no_means: Oregon local ballot titles carry no official result-of-vote text, so these are neutral one-sentence descriptions written by the collector, grounded strictly in the official ballot question/summary. Contingency (official text): 24-526 (dissolve Mt. Angel Fire District, Marion), 3-640 (dissolve Monitor RFPD, Clackamas) and 24-529 (form Mt. Angel-Monitor Fire District) each take effect only if all three are approved. Arguments of kind 'explainer' on the YES side quote the rationale that the official ballot title/explanatory statement attributes to the sponsoring governing body; they are not filed pamphlet arguments. No comparable NO-side statement exists in the official text. Pamphlet access limit: WebFetch converts the Marion County voters' pamphlet PDF to only its first 118,524 characters (through p. 38, ending mid-sentence in the 24-528 explanatory statement); the Clackamas pamphlet (docs.clackamas.us/.../03f4f9db-...) is likewise cut off at p. C-33 in candidate statements. Pages 39-45 (remaining measures and any filed arguments) could not be read, so the existence of filed pamphlet arguments for 24-526, 24-528 (partly), 24-529, 24-530 and 24-531 is UNCONFIRMED; a verifier with full PDF access should check. Search budget: the shared WebSearch budget for this run was exhausted partway through step 3; the measure-number search was run for both sides, but the T3 allowed-domain search could not be run for either side. Equal effort was kept: the same searches ran for YES and NO. DISCREPANCY: inventory title 'Dissolution of Mt. Angel Fire District Contingent Other Measures' appends the pamphlet's sample-ballot section heading 'Contingent Other Measures'; the caption is 'Dissolution of Mt. Angel Fire District' (used here). Effective dates differ between documents: ballot summary says dissolution effective December 31, 2026 with new-district services from January 1, 2027; explanatory statement says territory joins the new district effective January 1, 2027. Marion SEL 803 PDF for 24-526 shows a blank form in WebFetch. The Clackamas 3-640 document (docs.clackamas.us/.../6e11de2e-...) returned only the accommodation notice.
